themes.consensus_view: Banks across eight desks flag the start of Kevin Warsh's term as Fed chair as a near-term policy catalyst, generally framing him as more hawkish, but none has staked a clear directional market call yet.

facts_agreed.claim: Eight banks reference Kevin Warsh's incoming Fed chairmanship as a near-term policy catalyst, with several characterizing his stance as hawkish.
evidence_quotes: Kevin Warsh hawkish Fed chair transition
Kevin Warsh's rejection of forward guidance
Fed Chair Kevin Warsh first FOMC meeting

themes.consensus_view: Banks broadly note the Fed is dialing back the explicit roadmaps it gives markets, but they split on whether that is a credibility win or a recipe for more market whipsaw.

facts_agreed.claim: The Fed is reducing the explicit forward guidance and easing-bias signals it gives markets.
evidence_quotes: End of Fed forward guidance hand-holding

facts_contested.claim: Whether removing forward guidance is positive or negative for markets
facts_contested.for_evidence: Warsh proved to be hawkish not only on rates, but—most importantly—on the Fed’s institutional credibility.
facts_contested.against_evidence: We are going to get more market volatility. More false starts in mkt expectations.

themes.consensus_view: Banks are doubtful that the recent US-Iran agreement will quickly bring Iranian oil back to market, treating it as a fragile truce whose path to a real deal is uncertain.

facts_agreed.claim: Banks doubt the US-Iran agreement is a durable peace and see the path to a final deal as uncertain.
evidence_quotes: the Versailles MoU could be not a peace but an armistice for 20 weeks
peace is likely, but the path remains uncertain

themes.consensus_view: Five banks reference the Strait of Hormuz oil-shipping situation as a live macro factor tied to the US-Iran ceasefire, but none has staked a directional view on whether flows stay disrupted or fully normalize.

facts_agreed.claim: Multiple banks flag the Strait of Hormuz shipping situation, framed around disruption versus reopening and normalization, as a live topic this window.
evidence_quotes: Strait of Hormuz commercial shipping safety

themes.consensus_view: Several banks flag UK politics and fiscal direction as a live risk, with one warning UK government bonds (gilts) could stay weak under looser spending, but nobody has staked a firm directional view.

facts_agreed.claim: Multiple banks flag UK political and fiscal direction as a current risk worth watching.

themes.consensus_view: Several trading desks reference shifts in the yield curve (the gap between short- and long-term government bond rates) as a live macro signal, but they point in different directions and none has staked a primary directional bet.

facts_agreed.claim: Multiple desks flag the shape of the yield curve as an active topic this window, citing both flattening and steepening dynamics across regions.
evidence_quotes: bear flattening of the yield curve
